import Fastify from "fastify";

const fastify = Fastify();

function listUsersAdvanced() {}

fastify.route({
  method: "GET",
  url: "/users/advanced",
  schema: {
    tags: ["users", "advanced"],
    response: {
      200: {
        type: "array",
      },
    },
  },
  handler: listUsersAdvanced,
});
